```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
eco_effects <- data %>% 
  select(mpa_effect, climate_effect) %>% 
  group_by(mpa_effect, climate_effect) %>% 
  count(mpa_effect, climate_effect, name = "count")

heatmap_v2 <- ggplot(data = eco_effects, aes(x = climate_effect, y = mpa_effect, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    x = "Climate Impact",
    y = "MPA Effect",
    fill = "Number of occurrences"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("positive_population" = "Population (+)", 
                              "positive_ecosystem" = "Ecosystem (+)",
                              "no_effect" = "No effect", 
                              "negative_population" = "Population (-)",
                              "negative_ecosystem" = "Ecosystem (-)"),
                   limits = c("negative_population", "negative_ecosystem", "positive_population", "positive_ecosystem", "no_effect")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("body_size" = "Body Size",
                                 "disease_parasite" = "Disease & Parasitism",
                                 "habitat_formation" = "Habitat Formation",
                                 "mortality" = "Mortality",
                                 "movement_range" = "Movement & Range Shifts",
                                 "phenology" = "Phenology",
                                 "reproduction" = "Reproduction"),
                   limits = c("mortality", "habitat_formation", "body_size", "movement_range", "disease_parasite", "reproduction", "phenology")) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "grey",
                      high = "black") +
  my_theme() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 5)),
  )

heatmap_v2
```
